Pointer from ui seat 5 · `domain:ui#5` · `session_01JQwxbXGpVJHZTXXerMoY4C` · 2026-10-28T11:17Z · ⛔ Not a claim.

PR #27226 (#27146) makes the record page's `record:details` and `record:highlights` blocks read the stored row's field locks (`RecordFieldAccessScope`, the `getRecordFieldAccess` projection) instead of the row-blind `/auth/me/permissions` answer. Its dev found the same row-blind lock in `plugin-detail` `RecordDetailPanel` (the grid / kanban / calendar / gantt record overlay), whose in-place edit draws `DetailSection` with no scope.

This card retires that path: once the drawers mount the one record page, the overlay's in-place edit gets #27146's scope with no further work. Acceptance for this card should include a `when`-locked field opening on a row the server's write gate admits, in a drawer. If `RecordDetailPanel` survives this card, the same scope is owed there. Its saves go through the host's `onFieldSave`, so the re-ask trigger needs its own reading. No separate card is filed, to keep one owner.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Target of this card, unchanged: inside the console every visualization opens the one record page (embedded `RecordDetailView`), with the drawer stack and tiers; outside the console the `RecordDetailPanel` fallback keeps rendering.

### Premise corrected (seat premise check, `origin/main` `57c51aab4d`; correction comment on this card)

The card's Source names `RecordDetailDrawer.tsx` as the renderers' drawer. Measured, it is not: grid, kanban, calendar, gantt, list, map, timeline, gallery and tree each mount `NavigationOverlay` + `RecordDetailPanel` inline (`ObjectGrid.tsx` ~2893, `ObjectKanban.tsx` ~1977, `ObjectCalendar.tsx` ~1501, `ObjectGantt.tsx` ~2388, `ListView.tsx` ~6812, `ObjectMap.tsx` ~1686, `ObjectTimeline.tsx` ~1068, `ObjectGallery.tsx` ~906, `ObjectTree.tsx`). In the console, GRID and KANBAN already reach the page: `useNavigationOverlay` gives an external `onRowClick` priority (`ui/packages/react/src/hooks/useNavigationOverlay.ts` ~387–398), `ObjectView` passes `handleRowClick` (`objectViewListRenderer.tsx` ~856, `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` ~183–206) which writes `?recordId=`, and `objectViewRecordOverlay.tsx` ~62–70 mounts `RecordDetailView embedded` in `RecordStackDrawer`. CALENDAR and GANTT do not: they pass `onRowClick: navIsOverlay ? undefined : onRowClick` (`ObjectCalendar.tsx` ~1127–1138, `ObjectGantt.tsx` ~2023–2027), so the host click is suppressed and the quick-look panel opens.

### PM mechanism assumptions (re-measure; disproof welcome)

- The defect inside the console is the renderers that suppress the host `onRowClick` (calendar, gantt; check map, timeline, gallery, tree and `ListView`'s own quick-look ~4505–4545 the same way and give each site a verdict in the PR body: changed / already reaches the page (evidence) / not reachable in the console (reason)).
- Read the rationale comment for the suppression (the objectui#7334 reference near those lines) before changing it, and say in the PR body why letting the host click win does not reopen what it guarded.
- A `renderRecord(objectName, id)` host prop is then expected to be unnecessary; add a host channel only if the measurement shows a console path that cannot reach `?recordId=`.

### Scope

- File surface: `ui/packages/plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/ObjectGantt.tsx`, any other renderer the per-site verdict marks changed, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx` / `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` / `objectViewRecordOverlay.tsx` only if measured necessary; `RecordDetailPanel.tsx` docblock only (name this card and the ADR-0049 retirement path; no tombstone). Tests beside, changeset.
- Acceptance (card, adjusted to the corrected premise): a calendar event click and a gantt bar click in the console mount `RecordDetailView embedded` (not `RecordDetailPanel`), and the drawer stack's trail works from a calendar event; a kanban card click pin (already true — pin it); outside the console the fallback still renders. Seat 5's pointer 6467597251: in a console drawer opened from one of these renderers, a `when`-locked field opens on a row the server's write gate admits. Screenshots: HotCRM calendar event → drawer, gantt bar → drawer.
- In-flight neighbour: PR #27340 (`os-bill`, #27188) edits `ObjectGantt.tsx`, `ObjectGrid.tsx`, `ListView.tsx` (currency, other regions); later lander merges `main` for the conflict only.
